remarks: Not your typical cape. This renovated home is charming and welcoming. Conveniently located in a quiet and highly desirable neighborhood. Owners take excellent care of this home and property-just move in and smile . Everything begins with the inviting screened in front porch. Spacious living room with hardwood floors leads to both the dining room and the eat in kitchen. Kitchen features a huge pantry, eat in area, newer appliances, and access to laundry room, basement and back yard. First floor also includes a good size bedroom and renovated full bath. Second floor has Master Bedroom, full bath and 3rd bedroom. Plenty of storage and cute spaces for you to creatively use. Lower level is finished and makes for great additional living space-again get creative in the way you'd like to use it. Detached garage and nice size back yard to enjoy the outdoors round out this gem. See it today, rent it tomorrow!
